B: Hi, Ginny. Wow! You have a lot of things for sale!

B: Yes, please. I'd like to exchange this green cap. I bought it yesterday, but the color doesn't look good on me.
W: Which color would you like instead?
B: ⓐ <u>Can you recommend another color for me?</u>
W: Sure. I think this white one and the brown one are nice. Which do you prefer?
B: I like both. Can I try them on?
W: Of course. You can look in this mirror.
B: Okay... Oh, I really like this brown one. I'll take it!
W: Okay, I'll get you a new one.
B: Thank you.

questions.promptEn:
14 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)가 가리키는 것을 지문에서 찾아 두 단어로 쓰시오.
Hello, I'm Jimin. Have you ever shared (A) <u>things like bikes, books, or toys that you've already used</u>? Sharing saves resources and money, and it is good for the environment. Let me tell you about my experience with the sharing economy.

Last week, I used an app (B) <u>to get</u> a backpack. The app allows users easily buy and sell secondhand items. (①) Sometimes, people also give away items which they don't need anymore. (②) Someone was giving it away. (③) It looked as good as a new one. (④) So, I sent a message to the person who posted it. (⑤)

Jimin: Hello, can I get the backpack?
User 1: Sure.
Jimin: Great! How can I get it?
User 1: Can you come to Central Park at 3:00 p.m. tomorrow?
Jimin: Sure! I'll see you then. Thank you!
